lines: At first, I thought the sound was coming
from the fan above the kitchen door.
Then I listened again, and again,
until I noticed the same pattern in every room.
It was the old clock in the hallway,
ticking much louder than I remembered.
We moved it away from the microphone
and recorded another minute of silence.
This time, the background was quiet
enough for the interview we had planned.
